verdict.rationale: An audit log is a fair governance question for a code-hosting platform like Bitbucket, but nothing in the evidence pack documents an audit log of user or administrative actions. The nearby items cover other things: SOC2/ISO compliance, granular permissions, 2FA and IP allowlisting, and centralized pipeline visibility. None of these is an audit trail, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can review an audit log of user and administrative actions
